newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ATLETICO MADRID V STEAUA BUCHAREST TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ATLETICO MADRID V STEAUA BUCHAREST TEAMS.

Steaua - 12-Daniel Gherasim, 3-Roland Nagi, 4-Tiberiu Csik, 5-Bogdan Bucur, 6-Daniel Prodan, 8-Damian Militaru, 9-Aurel Calin, 11-Sabin Ilie, 15-Marius Baciu, 17-Laurentiu Rosu, 22-Dennis Serban.
